name: Throttle / Boost last deck card after assets
notes: Exactly one card remains in Deck when Throttle red is announced. Accept optional Boost, but leave that card in Deck while resources/AP are unpaid. Pitch Generic Wounding Blow blue for3, pay printed2 and one AP, then successfully banish the sole current top card face up as the additional effect-cost. Emptying Deck this way does not invalidate the paid card. Zero to Sixty blue is Mechanologist, so the attack gains go again, deals6 unblocked, leaves opponent14 and returns AP1; resources stay1 and no banish-play permission is granted.
